title: Riven Tides - Patch Notes 1.26.0
body:
# Riven Tides - Patch Notes 1.26.0

Raiders,

Scout reports have started arriving from Riven Tides. Bits of observation logs, worn photographs, and coastal footage have finally reached Speranza.

Now it is your turn to see it firsthand. Walk the abandoned shoreline, move through the Exodus port, and take in the faded luxury of the Panorama Azzurro hotel.

This is the Rust Belt, and it will not be forgiving. Other Raiders are already chasing new loot here, and a new airborne ARC unit has been spotted watching over the area. Its purpose, and how to deal with it, are things you'll have to learn yourself.

# What's New?

* Riven Tides Map

* Beachcombing Map Condition

* A new minor Map Condition found only on Riven Tides

* Dig for hidden treasure along the beaches of Riven Tides. Bring the correct tool for the job, and stay alert for surprises along the way.

* New Enemy - ARC Turbine

* Expedition Window

* New Items

* Epic Gadget - Powered Descender

* Uncommon Throwable - Crash Mat

* Common Deployable - White Flag

* Common Gadget - Dockmaster's Detector

* New Player Project - Avian Alarm

* Last Resort Event: Earn merits by collecting ship models and gaining XP across the different maps to unlock rewards

* "Wind Sprite" Ship Model

* "Twilight Compass" Ship Model

* "Velocity" Ship Model

* "Sirena Dorata" Ship Model

* "Leviathan's Crown" Ship Model

* Trials Season 4

* The Solare Set

* The Rachetta Set

* New Augment: Tactical Mk.3 (Smoke)

* **Dev note:** With another Tactical Augment arriving in this patch, we want to acknowledge that some Augments, especially the Combat ones, are underperforming compared to where we'd like them to be. A general balance pass for Augments is in progress, aimed at strengthening the weaker options, with particular attention to the Combat Mk. 3 (Flanking) Augment, which still hasn't found a strong use case. We also want to make sure every Augment category has a well-rounded set of options.

# Patch Highlights:

* Trigger 'Nade balancing

* Repairing changes

* Bettina Buff

# Balance Changes

## Weapon Economy Adjustments

The balance of the weapon economy has been drifting, with heavy PVP players constantly forced into tough choices about their weapons, while more passive players keep accumulating them without much cost. We're aiming to even this out so weapon attrition challenges everyone, while also giving players new tools to manage it.

## New feature: Repair on upgrade

Upgrading a weapon has been costly when you first need to repair it, which made the whole process feel inaccessible. To make repairing low-durability weapons easier and smooth out the upgrade loop:

* **Upgrading weapons will now repair 25% of the weapon's max durability**

## Weapon drop & durability

We're cutting down weapon spawns near the edges of maps, so high-tier zones and locked rooms feel more valuable and tense.

At the same time, we're widening the range of durability that weapons can spawn with, while lowering the average outside locked rooms. The new repair-on-upgrade feature should offset this easily.

* Average durability on spawned weapons: 50 -> **30**

In practice, this means you could find a weapon with as little as 15 durability out in the open, while weapons inside locked rooms will still commonly sit around 60 durability.

## Weapon durability loss on shot

We've heard the frustration that keeping high-tier weapons running costs far more than maintaining low-tier ones. We want top-tier weapons to last noticeably longer than lower-tier ones, so durability loss per shot is being adjusted as follows:

* Common weapons: **+75% durability loss on shot**

* Uncommon weapons: **+50% durability loss on shot**

* Rare weapons: **+35% durability loss on shot**

* Epic weapons: **-5% durability loss on shot**

* Legendary weapons: **-10% durability loss on shot**

## Weapon durability loss on being knocked out

We want to make heavy PVP play a genuinely viable style within ARC Raiders, so to bring it more in line with other playstyles, we're cutting the durability loss weapons take when their owner is knocked out by 50%.

* Durability loss on weapons of a knocked out player: -30% durability -> **-15% durability**

## ARC

* Removed Comets from standard sessions in the Dam Battlegrounds.

* Significantly reduced Firefly presence in Dam Battlegrounds.

* Reduced Comet presence in Buried City.

**Dev note:** Adding Comets and Fireflies had pushed difficulty too high in sessions meant for newer players. To bring these back to their intended level, we've scaled back their presence where the impact was greatest.

## Gameplay

* Rebalanced how Exodus recyclables loot is distributed, spreading it more evenly across containers.

## Items

* Stack size increased 1 -> 3

* **Dev Note:** You can no longer throw a fresh grenade while triggering a previously thrown one at the same time; you now have to let the animations finish first. This is meant to cut down on Trigger 'Nade spam by widening the gap between throws, and to stop players from detonating a second grenade early using the first.

* Added a 1s delay after throwing, before the next throw or trigger action is allowed

* Added a 1.3s delay after triggering, before the next throw or trigger action is allowed

* Increased the weight of the Photoelectric Cloak from 1 to 3, bringing it closer in line with its rarity and cost

* Increased its Power use rate from 2.5/s to 10/s

* **Dev Note:** The Photoelectric Cloak has been performing too strongly, particularly around how long it could stay active. This change is meant to make each use more deliberate; its strength while active is unchanged, but you'll need to think sooner about finding cover or how you approach ARC-heavy areas.

## Weapons

**Dev Note:** The Bettina has been buffed to bring it closer to matching its rarity. Base damage and damage against ARC armor have both gone up so each bullet counts for more, while base fire rate has been reduced. Dispersion has been tuned to reward longer controlled bursts before accuracy drops off, and the heavy ammo stack size has been increased so carrying enough ammo is less of a burden. Together, these changes should make individual shots matter more while still letting well-controlled bursts land more hits.

* Base Damage increased from 14 to 16

* Base Fire-Rate reduced from 285 to 235

* Per Shot Dispersion reduced by around 40% (bloom now happens more slowly)

* Dispersion Recovery Time improved by around 30%

* Damage against ARC armor increased by around 33%

* Stack Size increased from 40 to 60

# Content and Bug Fixes

## ARC

* Fixed aim assist not correctly targeting leg joints and weak spots on Bastion, Bombardier, Queen, and Matriarch.

* Fixed an issue where Vaporizer and ARC Surveyor patrols could freeze in place until alerted.

* Fixed an issue where ARC enemies failed to react to nearby breaching sounds.

* Fixed a bug that let the Bastion be too accurate while switching targets mid-fire.

* Extended ARC presence to more maps and conditions.

## Animation

* Reworked the emote system so more emotes can now play while running. Give it a try.

## Audio

* Fixed a potential crash tied to voice-over data.

* Fixed an issue where Trader voice lines at the start of a round could play too often.

* Updated voice effects for cosmetic helmets.

* Fixed an issue where emote previews in the Store could play silently, missing their voice lines.

* Fixed an issue where footstep sounds could cut out.

* Fixed footstep and impact sounds on several surfaces (such as bridges) that were playing incorrect surface audio.

* Fixed an issue where objective and emote sounds could linger or double up after reconnecting to a match; audio now stops as expected.

* Added a noise suppression option for voice chat, for clearer communication.

* Fixed voice chat breaking after opening the platform UI.

## Cosmetics & Customization

* Fixed an issue where facial hair and face masks could briefly glitch when switching faces or outfits.

## Gameplay

* Fixed a bug that let deployables be placed inside extraction elevators before they opened.

* Fixed an issue where bullets could spawn from the wrong position when firing while standing on rotating or movable objects (such as Rocketeer debris).

* Fixed an issue where the "Death from Above" achievement could be earned by standing on destroyed Rocketeer parts.

* Fixed an issue where players signed up for an Expedition would fail to depart on schedule.

* Added a late departure option.

## Items

* Fixed an issue where binocular zoom levels weren't functioning.

* Fixed an issue where entering a zipline from above could cause fall damage or push the player into the ground on attachment.

* Fixed an issue where zipline anchors could sometimes turn invisible after being placed.

* Fixed an issue where using Vita Spray to heal yourself and others at once sped up the healing rate incorrectly.

## Maps

* Fixed several environment issues:

* Corrected floating and clipping props.

* Restored wind damage and indoor/outdoor detection.

* Resolved severe culling near the church.

* Fixed a spot where players could get stuck under an ARC wreck.

* Fixed an issue where some supply call stations couldn't be interacted with.

* Fixed spots where players could clip through walls and resolved flickering on some roofs.

* Fixed an issue where some supply call stations couldn't be interacted with.

* Fixed an issue where players could take shield damage while inside a building during Hurricane.

* Removed a problematic zipline in Old Town.

* Fixed several stuck spots, improved collision near the Launch Towers, and resolved texture flickering.

* Fixed an issue with multiple ladders in the trench that could launch players high into the air.

* Fixed several environment issues, including:

* A stuck spot near the cargo elevator.

* Clipping trees.

* Floating grass.

* Misaligned cafeteria props.

* Incorrect concrete materials.

* Fixed several common stuck spots to improve navigation.

## Movement

* Crouch movement speed is now capped to forced walk speed while using items.

* Fixed an issue where heavy landing could trigger at the wrong times.

## Performance

* Additional general performance improvements.

* Upgraded Intel XeSS to SDK version 3.0.0.

* Reduced rubber-banding when reaching the edge of the playable area.

## Quests

* Fixed an issue where Seeker Grenade eliminations didn't count toward progress in the "Safe Passage" quest.

## Social

* Added a popup that appears when trying to use Voice Chat while in a PlayStation Party, since the two cannot run together.

* Report reasons are now shown as a flat list instead of a dropdown, making all reporting options visible at once.

## Stability

* Fixed a server crash that could occur after a round ended, especially when players disconnected and reconnected.

* Fixed issues where missing an Expedition departure could freeze the game on load or make a character appear to be missing.

* Fixed a rare crash tied to certain items triggering visual or audio effects.

* Fixed a crash tied to certain outfits.

## UI

* Enabled multi-select in inventory by default on Project screens.

* Updated scrollbar styling in the customization panel.

* Added challenge previews to the practice range, letting you review challenge details before starting.

* Gave crafting suggestions priority over recycle suggestions when trying to gather resources.

* Fixed "Ping Destination" sometimes showing the wrong text message.

* Updated the departure screen with a progress bar tracking your Expedition quest, and added catch-up information.

* Moved the sign-up status to the left side of the main menu and reduced the number of Quests and Feats shown.

* Updated the Late Departure notification to show only the number of rewards and catch-up rewards.

* The progression display no longer shows the final step.

* Moved and updated the sign-up status widget in the menu to fit the new carousel layout.

* Fixed an issue where the Expedition screen could fail to move to the final stage after completing Step 5, causing the Departure view and Skill Points progress to go missing.

* Fixed an issue where quest tracking could show up in the map menu for players who hadn't started an Expedition.

* Updated the text on the Expedition explanation screen for clarity.

* Added a countdown timer and refined the visuals of the Confirm Departure prompt in Expeditions.

* The Expedition screen now shows the timer across all steps for clearer progress tracking.

* The Expedition About page now shows only Expedition Rewards, no longer displaying skill points.

* Enabled step previews in Expeditions.

* Fixed Expedition quest titles, descriptions, and objectives not displaying correctly in the departure screen and tracker.

* Added a proper departure notification and corrected Expedition icon behavior.

* Fixed an issue where using a controller in the Projects screen could block returning to reward previews after pressing Close.

* The event preview now only shows the project button when the event is active and unlocked.

* Fixed an issue where project goals could appear selected while previewing future or past steps in the Projects screen.

* Fixed an issue where the Seasonal Project panel on the Home menu could display an outdated step.

* Added a Show/Hide Tooltip prompt to the Inspect tab in the Inventory.

* Fixed the Surge Coil tooltip so it now correctly shows the item's actual range (10m) instead of the previous incorrect value (75m).

* All emote wheel slots can now be rebound to any emote.

* Added a button to reset the emote wheel back to its default state on the emote selection screen.

* Fixed an issue where the weapon display didn't always account for all stash slots.

* Fixed an issue where the Acquire Resources menu could show suggestions from locked Workshop stations.

## VFX

* Bullet holes now properly track any shot object as it moves.

* Reduced visual popping on character clothing when changing camera distance, making movement and zoom look more consistent.

* Improved the visual effect of the ARC Surveyor beam that calls in the Assessor.

## KNOWN ISSUES

* In rare cases, purchases might fail on the customization screen; reopening the screen resolves it.

* The Firefly can sometimes vanish after going idle and drop an incendiary grenade.

* Shredders float to the ceiling in some rooms of the Hidden Bunker.

* ARC enemies may spawn inside geometry on The Dam.

* Flying ARC units may sometimes appear stuck in an idle state.

* The 'Purchase Raider Tokens' page may appear in front of the inbox and profile page when switching between them.

* Player animations may look broken if a search of the Baron Husk is interrupted.

* The "Off The Radar" Quest cannot be completed on Riven Tides.

* There is a visual issue when viewing the "Crash Mat" in spectator mode.

* The Leaper can jump through the Turbine.

* The Event Skin Preview incorrectly shows post-round event progress.

* The Rachetta outfit is missing some of the color details shown in promotional material; this will be corrected in a future patch.
